option.counterfactual: Every smoothly bounded pseudoconvex compact domain in every dimension n≥2 has an Oka complement, and an established theorem already proves this.
option.approach: Examine the exact hypotheses of complement theorems recorded in the workspaces, looking specifically for one covering arbitrary smooth pseudoconvex closures rather than polynomially convex compact sets. If such a theorem applies, use it to establish S directly.
